title: Jinja2 templates
description:
Jinja2 beyond macros: extends and blocks, include, import, call blocks and namespaces.
See `:help dbdash-templates`.

show.title: extends, block, include
show.description:
`parts/report.sql` lays out the query; this panel `extends` it and fills its blocks,
`super()` keeping the base's own columns, and `include`s a shared WHERE fragment.

show.title: call, namespace, set block, filters
show.description:
`call` wraps text in a macro (`caller()`), `namespace()` keeps a count across a loop,
`set` blocks capture output, `for ... if` filters a loop.

show.title: Players per rank (a loop over sorted mappings)
show.description: A loop over mappings sorted with `sort(attribute=...)`, grouped and drawn as bars.

show.title: extends (two levels), super(), self.title(), scoped, required
show.description:
Two levels of `extends` (page.sql <- section.sql <- this): `super()`, `self.title()`,
`scoped` and `required` blocks.

show.title: import and include: context, exports, missing files
show.description:
`import` exporting top-level variables (not `_private` ones), `with` / `without
context`, `include ... without context`, `ignore missing`, and a list of names (the
first that exists).
